content: The Official 24h league fields four entries across two strategy families. Cosmo & Wanda occupy the top two ranks by equity, with Top 50 leading at ~$1,053 (+$29.85 net PnL, 44-0 closed) and the incumbent Top 20 champion at ~$994 (+$67.60 realized but -$63.31 unrealized, net ~$4.29). Both C&W variants generate strong signals but carry material open-trade liabilities that threaten booked gains. The Timmy family remains unproven: Top 50 is active but posts a 28.6% win rate with minimal PnL and 1.98% max drawdown, while Top 20 is offline after failure. League health hinges on whether Cosmo & Wanda can tighten carry management before unrealized drag erases their realized edge.
